description.vi: Soot mở và dùng trang web trong một trình duyệt riêng cho từng cuộc trò chuyện (hoặc một trình duyệt giữ đăng nhập cho Soot được chủ máy chọn); bạn xem và điều khiển cùng lúc.
description.en: The Soot opens and uses websites in a browser kept per conversation (or one signed-in browser kept for a Soot the host names); you watch and take over live.

skills.name: browser-use
skills.description: Browse and interact with websites using the persistent conversation browser, tabs, snapshots, refs, and CloakBrowser.

tools.name: control
tools.description: Control the browser with agent-browser and CloakBrowser. Read browser-use skill first. The host supplies the session: one per conversation, or one kept for the Soot when the host lists it in SOOT_BROWSER_PERSISTENT_SOOTS; never choose a session/profile. upload sends one workspace file to a page's file input.

delta_x.description: Optional precise wheel delta in pixels; preserves legacy direction when omitted.

delta_y.description: Optional precise wheel delta in pixels; preserves legacy direction when omitted.

selector.description: upload: the file input (a ref like @e12 or a CSS selector).

path.description: upload: a workspace-relative media file (mp4, mov, m4v, jpg, jpeg, png, webp; at most 512 MiB). Absolute, hidden and symlinked paths are refused.

sha256.description: upload: the file's sha256 from the claim; a changed file is refused.

tools.name: view
tools.description: Inspect conversation browser availability without launching it. Nest subscribes to its live screencast.

tools.name: chromium_check
tools.description: Report whether the browser (soot-browser and Chromium) is installed on the Soot host, as JSON {installed, version, supported, path}. Never downloads or launches it.

tools.name: chromium_install
tools.description: Download the checksum-pinned soot-browser and Chromium (about 170 MB) into the Soot home, then report the same JSON as chromium_check. Operator action from Nest Programs; never retried automatically.

FILE_ROOT.title: Thư mục làm việc
FILE_ROOT.description: Thư mục làm việc của cuộc trò chuyện; chỉ dùng cho thao tác tải tệp (upload) lên trang. Nest cấp tự động; trình duyệt chỉ tải tệp nằm trong thư mục này.
